edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner in the constructor, granting unrestricted privileged role to the deployer

ChangeOwner overwrites the owner state variable, transferring all privileged rights to _newOwner
AddModerator sets moderators[_newModerator] = true, granting authorization rights
AddModerator executes the unchecked totalModerators += 1 increment
the unchecked increment writes the totalModerators state variable and can silently overflow uint16
RemoveModerator sets moderators[_oldModerator] = false, revoking authorization rights
RemoveModerator executes the unchecked totalModerators -= 1 decrement
the unchecked decrement writes the totalModerators state variable and can underflow uint16
UpdateMaintaining writes the caller-supplied boolean into the isMaintaining state variable
setConfigClass writes layingEggLevels[_classId]
setConfigClass writes layingEggDeductions[_classId]
setConfigClass writes transformLevels[_classId]
setConfigClass writes transformClasses[_classId]
addRandomClass pushes _newClassId onto the randomClassIds array
removeRandomClass overwrites, deletes from and shrinks the randomClassIds array
removeRandomClass performs the manual unchecked randomClassIds.length-- shrink
the unchecked length decrement mutates randomClassIds.length without bounds validation
initMonsterClassConfig repeatedly invokes setConfigClass to seed the configuration mappings
getRandomClassId reads randomClassIds.length and indexes the array with _seed modulo that length
getLayEggInfo reads layingEggLevels[_classId] as the layingLevel return value
getLayEggInfo reads layingEggDeductions[_classId] as the layingCost return value
getTransformInfo reads transformClasses[_classId] as the transformClassId return value
getTransformInfo reads transformLevels[_classId] as the level return value
getClassTransformInfo reads layingEggLevels[_classId]
getClassTransformInfo reads layingEggDeductions[_classId]
getClassTransformInfo reads transformLevels[_classId]
getClassTransformInfo reads transformClasses[_classId]

_classId is only used as the shared mapping key of the four configuration writes performed by setConfigClass

_layingCost is only used as the value written into layingEggDeductions inside setConfigClass
_transformLevel is only used as the value written into transformLevels inside setConfigClass
_tranformClass is only used as the value written into transformClasses inside setConfigClass
_newClassId is only used as the value pushed onto randomClassIds inside addRandomClass
_oldClassId is only used as the search key for the swap-and-pop removal inside removeRandomClass
_seed is only used to compute the randomClassIds index inside getRandomClassId
_classId is only used as the mapping key for the two reads performed by getLayEggInfo
_classId is only used as the mapping key for the two reads performed by getTransformInfo
